title: Survey Design & Multi-Stage Sampling (NSSO Standards)

title: National Accounts & Macroeconomic Aggregates (SNA 2008)
description: Comprehensive training on GVA and GDP computation, Supply-Use Tables, capital stock estimation, and transition to UN System of National Accounts.

title: Compilation & Analysis of Price Indices (CPI, WPI & IIP)
description: Practical methodology for base year revision, basket price collection, Laspeyres index formulation, and core inflation modeling.

title: Statistical Inference & Hypothesis Testing for Public Data
description: Parametric and non-parametric hypothesis tests, confidence intervals, p-value interpretation, and regression analysis for policy evaluation.

title: Time Series Forecasting for Economic Governance
description: ARIMA, seasonal adjustment methods (X-13ARIMA-SEATS), structural break detection, and macroeconomic trend forecasting.

title: Python for Public Sector Data Analysis
description: Hands-on Python, Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib specifically designed for civil servants processing large administrative datasets and CSV/Excel exports.

title: Advanced Python Automation for Statistical Workflows
description: Automate routine data reconciliation, web scraping of state port data, batch cleaning, and scheduled reporting pipelines using Python.

title: Enterprise SQL & Database Querying for Public Registries
description: Writing complex multi-table JOINs, window functions, CTEs, and aggregated subqueries on PostgreSQL and Oracle statistical databases.

title: Applied Machine Learning for Official Statistics
description: Supervised algorithms, anomaly detection in tax/census filings, natural language text classification for economic activity coding, and scikit-learn pipelines.

title: Intro to QGIS & Spatial Analytics for Census Data
description: Creating thematic maps, district choropleths, spatial clustering of village amenities, and handling shapefiles and GeoTIFFs using open-source QGIS.

title: Data Visualization & Executive BI Dashboards
description: Designing clear interactive dashboards, KPI heatmaps, and visual charts for ministry review meetings using PowerBI and modern charting libraries.

title: DPDP Act 2023: Compliance Framework for Data Custodians
description: Understanding obligations under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, lawful grounds for processing citizen data, data fiduciary roles, and privacy audits.

title: GovTech Cybersecurity & CERT-In Compliance Guidelines
description: Mandatory cybersecurity measures, role-based access control, incident reporting protocols to CERT-In, and securing internal databases from data leaks.

title: Open Government Data & National Data Analytics Platform (NDAP)
description: Publishing open data under NDSAP, metadata standardization, utilizing NDAP APIs, and facilitating public data accessibility.

title: Data Quality Assurance, Field Scrutiny & Validation Rules
description: Designing automated validation checklists, non-sampling error detection, field enumerator supervision, and data consistency algorithms.

title: Inter-Departmental Data Sharing & API Standards
description: Federal data governance, REST API standards for inter-ministerial data exchange, DigiLocker integration, and semantic schema harmonization.

title: Policy Briefing & Translating Analytics for Decision Makers
description: Crafting concise 1-page cabinet notes, non-technical executive summaries of complex statistical surveys, and oral briefing techniques.

title: Cross-Departmental Stakeholder Coordination & Consensus
description: Negotiating data sharing agreements between central ministries and state directorates, running steering committees, and conflict resolution.

title: Evidence-Based Policy Formulation & Impact Assessment
description: Formulating developmental program evaluations, randomized control trials in governance, cost-benefit analysis, and statistical evidence synthesis.

title: Field Team Leadership & Large Survey Project Management
description: Resource planning for census and nationwide field operations, enumerator motivation, milestone tracking, and survey logistics management.

title: Analytical Problem Solving & Root Cause Diagnosis in Surveys
description: Structured root cause analysis for high non-response rates, outlier investigation, statistical troubleshooting, and corrective protocol deployment.

title: RTI Act & Public Information Governance
description: Balancing Right to Information mandates with data privacy protections, handling statistical disclosure risks, and proactive disclosure protocols.

title: Spatial Modeling & Geospatial Indicators for SDGs
description: Tracking UN Sustainable Development Goals using remote sensing datasets, satellite imagery, and spatial regression in public policymaking.

title: Automated Survey Processing & Field Data Reconciliation
description: Techniques for computer-assisted personal interviewing (CAPI), real-time field error scrubbing, and multi-round survey tabulation.

title: Modern Econometric Modeling for Macro-Forecasting
description: Vector Autoregression (VAR), Error Correction Models, and cointegration testing for assessing monetary and fiscal policy shocks.
